title: Ability to pin frequently-used files to jumplists
line: Recent files in a task manager entry's context menu can now be pinned, so they stay in a Pinned Files section above the recent ones.
explanation: The task manager's context menu showed only the five most recently used files of an app, so a document opened often but not recently dropped out of it, and there was no way to keep one there. The change adds a Pin File submenu under the recent files; a pinned file is stored as an Activity Manager resource link for that app (the same mechanism Kickoff favorites use) and shows in a new Pinned Files section above Recent Files, with an Unpin File submenu to remove it. Pinned files are left out of the recent list and are kept when Forget Recent Files is used.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: allow pinning files to the context menu

The context menu only lists the last few recent files, so a document you
open often can drop out of it. A Pin File submenu now pins a recent file
to a Pinned Files section above them, which Unpin File removes it from.

BUG: 423365

media.caption: Kate's context menu on master: only the five most recent files, no way to keep one.
With the patch: two pinned files in their own section above Recent Files, with Pin File and Unpin File submenus.
The Pin File submenu lists the recent files; picking one pins it.
After Forget Recent Files and unpinning todo.txt, only meeting-notes.txt is left, pinned.
